description: Minister of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order CINEC Campus (Pvt) Ltd. (Early Childhood Education).
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Education exercising powers under the Universities Act to amend the recognition of a private degree-awarding institute (CINEC Campus) and add a new degree program. While it mentions a government minister by name, the core content focuses on educational regulations, degree program accreditation, and academic qualification requirements rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications. This falls under educational matters not covered by the specialized categories 1-9.
